execution.objective: Provide a Gemini-generated SLL learning experience for English and IELTS, with a visitor allowance, regular user-account signup, and SLL ebook access.
success_criteria: Show the SLL experience only on /hub/sbu/education/lambsbook-tutoring, not /journeys/learn.
Offer General English and IELTS preparation modes.
Generate an English model answer and semantic tree from the learner's question or task using Gemini.
Use the global English, Vietnamese, or Chinese selection for meaning support.
Keep GEMINI_API_KEY server-side; validate and bound input and output.
Disclose that prompts are sent to Gemini; do not persist or log prompts or answers.
Do not claim official IELTS scoring, mastery, or proficiency.
Pass release guard and production build; founder runtime review remains required.
Translate all visible Lambsbook Tutoring page copy using the selected global English, Vietnamese, or Chinese language.
Unauthenticated visitors can generate up to three examples per day.
A signed-in Supabase user can use SLL without becoming a canonical member.
SLL signup uses the regular user role and does not create a member record.
Explain the account benefit and SLL method in the selected English, Vietnamese, or Chinese language.
Provide a button to the free SLL ebook folder.
Keep learner prompts and generated answers out of persistent storage and logs.
Clearly tell signed-out visitors the SLL allowance is three examples per 24 hours and offer signup for a regular user account.
Clearly distinguish regular user SLL access from canonical membership.
Add a Programs navigation path from the Education page to Lambsbook Tutoring and SLL, using an extensible program-list pattern.

experience_contract.privacy: Disclose Gemini processing. Do not persist or log prompt or generated content.
sll_boundary: Do not change SLL ontology or semantic controls.
Do not create or modify learner evidence or curriculum authority.
Do not add a database, analytics, or persistence.
experience_contract.account_signup: Use regular Supabase user signup with explicit user role; do not use member signup or create canonical membership.
experience_contract.account_access: Unlimited SLL generation for authenticated Supabase users, subject to abuse protection.
experience_contract.guest_quota_storage: Server-side, non-persistent counter; do not store prompts or generated answers.

founder_runtime_test.test_definition: On the Lambsbook Tutoring page, try both modes and switch the global language menu among English, Vietnamese, and Chinese.
founder_runtime_test.expected_outcome: Gemini returns a bounded model answer and semantic tree; meaning support follows the selected language; /journeys/learn has no SLL widget; learner content is not persisted.
